topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I can't believe this. Just when I thought I'd seen it all, I get this box from out of nowhere. It's like, what is this, some kind of joke? I mean, a gift? From a student who's been gone for years? What was the point? Did they think a little care package was going to make up for all the mess they left behind? I don’t need their charity or their pity. I was there, I did my part, and now they send me this stuff like it’s supposed to change something. It doesn’t. Nothing’s changed.
